### Pick the first HumanoidMotion with the same display name

Rejected. Display names and target-list order are presentation, not stable identity. Ambiguous portable candidates require an import/catalog decision, not an Editor guess.
new:
### Generate HumanoidMotion lazily when an Animation Set is resolved

Rejected. Portable Humanoid content belongs to the imported logical motion, not to one scene entity or one Animation Set usage. Lazy generation would make authoring candidates depend on whether a target happened to be assigned and would keep `a / Humanoid` absent until runtime/editor resolution touched the motion. Import/reimport must create the candidate as soon as the motion has sufficient canonical Humanoid source context.
